4029static void led_overlay_square(uint8_t led, uint8_t tb_gain, uint32_t elapsed,
4030 uint32_t radius, uint8_t fade, uint8_t breathe,
4031 uint8_t *r, uint8_t *g, uint8_t *b) {
4032 if (s_tb_on && led_takeback_has(led)) {
4033 *r = 0;
4034 *g = led_scale_u8(255, tb_gain);
4035 *b = led_scale_u8(255, tb_gain);
4036 }
4037 if (!s_ring_on || endgame_wave.active) {
4038 return;
4039 }
4040 {
4041 int slot = led_ring_slot(led);
4042 uint8_t rr;
4043 uint8_t gg;
4044 uint8_t bb;
4045 if (slot < 0 && led != s_ring_king_led) {
4046 return;
4047 }
4048 if (led == s_ring_king_led) {
4049 rr = led_scale_u8(255, breathe);
4050 gg = led_scale_u8(160, breathe);
4051 bb = 0;
4052 } else {
4053 uint8_t cheb = s_ring_cheb[slot];
4054 uint32_t t = (elapsed * 255U) / LED_RESIGN_SPREAD_MS;
4055 uint8_t green;
4056 uint8_t level = 0;
4057 if (t > 255U) {
4058 t = 255U;
4059 }
4060 green = (uint8_t)((140U * (255U - t)) / 255U);
4061 if (cheb < radius) {
4062 level = 56;
4063 } else if (cheb == radius) {
4064 level = 255;
4065 }
4066 rr = led_scale_u8(255, level);
4067 gg = led_scale_u8(green, level);
4068 bb = 0;
4069 }
4070 *r = (uint8_t)(((uint16_t)rr * (255U - fade) + (uint16_t)(*r) * fade) / 255U);
4071 *g = (uint8_t)(((uint16_t)gg * (255U - fade) + (uint16_t)(*g) * fade) / 255U);
4072 *b = (uint8_t)(((uint16_t)bb * (255U - fade) + (uint16_t)(*b) * fade) / 255U);
4073 }
4074}
4075
4076static void led_render_one(const led_tgt_t *t, uint16_t now16, uint8_t gain,
4077 uint8_t *r, uint8_t *g, uint8_t *b) {
4078 uint16_t elapsed = (uint16_t)(now16 - t->t0);
4079 if (t->pulse) {
4080 uint16_t half = LED_PULSE_MS / 2U;
4081 if (elapsed >= LED_PULSE_MS) {
4082 *r = t->tr;
4083 *g = t->tg;
4084 *b = t->tb;
4085 return;
4086 }
4087 if (elapsed < half) {
4088 uint8_t u = led_smoothstep(elapsed, half);
4089 *r = led_lerp_u8(t->sr, t->pr, u);
4090 *g = led_lerp_u8(t->sg, t->pg, u);
4091 *b = led_lerp_u8(t->sb, t->pb, u);
4092 return;
4093 }
4094 {
4095 uint8_t u = led_smoothstep((uint16_t)(elapsed - half), half);
4096 *r = led_lerp_u8(t->pr, t->tr, u);
4097 *g = led_lerp_u8(t->pg, t->tg, u);
4098 *b = led_lerp_u8(t->pb, t->tb, u);
4099 }
4100 return;
4101 }
4102 if (t->mode == LED_VIS_FADE) {
4103 uint8_t u = led_smoothstep(elapsed, LED_FADE_MS);
4104 *r = led_lerp_u8(t->sr, t->tr, u);
4105 *g = led_lerp_u8(t->sg, t->tg, u);
4106 *b = led_lerp_u8(t->sb, t->tb, u);
4107 return;
4108 }
4109 if (t->mode == LED_VIS_BREATHE) {
4110 uint8_t gnow = gain;
4111 if (t->br_period != 0U) {
4112 gnow = led_breathe_sq_gain(t->br_period, t->br_phase, t->br_floor);
4113 }
4114 *r = led_scale_u8(t->tr, gnow);
4115 *g = led_scale_u8(t->tg, gnow);
4116 *b = led_scale_u8(t->tb, gnow);
4117 } else {
4118 *r = t->tr;
4119 *g = t->tg;
4120 *b = t->tb;
4121 }
4122 if (t->br_fading && t->br_fade_ms != 0U) {
4123 uint16_t delay = t->br_delay;
4124 uint8_t u;
4125 if (elapsed < delay) {
4126 *r = t->sr;
4127 *g = t->sg;
4128 *b = t->sb;
4129 } else {
4130 u = led_smoothstep((uint16_t)(elapsed - delay), t->br_fade_ms);
4131 if (t->sr == 0U && t->sg == 0U && t->sb == 0U) {
4132 *r = led_scale_u8(*r, u);
4133 *g = led_scale_u8(*g, u);
4134 *b = led_scale_u8(*b, u);
4135 } else {
4136 *r = led_lerp_u8(t->sr, *r, u);
4137 *g = led_lerp_u8(t->sg, *g, u);
4138 *b = led_lerp_u8(t->sb, *b, u);
4139 }
4140 }
4141 }
4142}

4147 if (s_tgt[i].br_fading) {
4148 return true;
4149 }
4150 }
4151 return false;
4152}
4153
4154static void led_render_targets(void) {
4155 uint8_t rgb[LED_BOARD_N][3];
4156 uint8_t dirty[LED_BOARD_N];
4157 uint8_t gain;
4158 uint16_t now16;
4159 uint8_t i;
4160 if (s_picture_open || s_held_picture || s_board_show > 0 ||
4161 endgame_wave.active || s_forced_blackout || led_is_booting() ||
4162 led_game_pixels_blocked()) {
4163 return;
4164 }
4165 if (!led_tgt_lock()) {
4166 return;
4167 }
4168 {
4169 uint8_t force_now = s_hw_resync;
4170 s_hw_resync = 0U;
4171 s_force_hw = force_now;
4172 }
4173 gain = led_breathe_gain_now();
4174 now16 = (uint16_t)(esp_timer_get_time() / 1000);
4175 {
4176 uint32_t now_ms = (uint32_t)(esp_timer_get_time() / 1000);
4177 uint8_t tb_gain = 0;
4178 uint32_t ring_elapsed = 0;
4179 uint32_t ring_radius = 0;
4180 uint8_t ring_fade = 0;
4181 if (s_tb_on) {
4182 tb_gain = led_takeback_gain(now_ms);
4183 }
4184 if (s_ring_on && !endgame_wave.active) {
4185 uint32_t span;
4186 ring_elapsed = (uint32_t)(now_ms - s_ring_t0);
4187 if (ring_elapsed > LED_RESIGN_SPREAD_MS) {
4188 ring_elapsed = LED_RESIGN_SPREAD_MS;
4189 }
4190 if (s_ring_fade) {
4191 uint32_t fe = (uint32_t)(now_ms - s_ring_fade_t0);
4192 if (fe >= LED_RESIGN_FADE_MS) {
4193 s_ring_on = false;
4194 s_ring_fade = false;
4195 } else {
4196 ring_fade = (uint8_t)((fe * 255U) / LED_RESIGN_FADE_MS);
4197 }
4198 }
4199 span = s_ring_max == 0 ? 1U : s_ring_max;
4200 ring_radius = (ring_elapsed * span) / LED_RESIGN_SPREAD_MS;
4201 }
4202 for (i = 0; i < LED_BOARD_N; i++) {
4203 led_tgt_t *t = &s_tgt[i];
4204 uint8_t r = 0;
4205 uint8_t g = 0;
4206 uint8_t b = 0;
4207 uint16_t elapsed = (uint16_t)(now16 - t->t0);
4208 if (t->pulse && elapsed >= LED_PULSE_MS) {
4209 t->pulse = 0U;
4210 }
4211 if (t->mode == LED_VIS_FADE && elapsed >= LED_FADE_MS && !t->pulse) {
4212 t->mode = LED_VIS_SNAP;
4213 }
4214 led_render_one(t, now16, gain, &r, &g, &b);
4215 if (t->br_fading && t->br_fade_ms != 0U &&
4216 (uint16_t)(now16 - t->t0) >=
4217 (uint16_t)(t->br_delay + t->br_fade_ms)) {
4218 t->br_fading = 0U;
4219 }
4220 if (s_ring_on || s_tb_on) {
4221 led_overlay_square(i, tb_gain, ring_elapsed, ring_radius, ring_fade, gain,
4222 &r, &g, &b);
4223 }
4224 dirty[i] = (s_force_hw || r != t->out_r || g != t->out_g || b != t->out_b)
4225 ? 1U
4226 : 0U;
4227 if (dirty[i]) {
4228 t->out_r = r;
4229 t->out_g = g;
4230 t->out_b = b;
4231 rgb[i][0] = r;
4232 rgb[i][1] = g;
4233 rgb[i][2] = b;
4234 }
4235 }
4236 }
4237 led_tgt_unlock();
4238 s_target_write = 1U;
4239 for (i = 0; i < LED_BOARD_N; i++) {
4240 if (!dirty[i]) {
4241 continue;
4242 }
4243 led_set_pixel_channels(i, rgb[i][0], rgb[i][1], rgb[i][2], 0);
4244 }
4245 s_target_write = 0U;
4246 s_force_hw = 0U;
4247}

4249static void led_privileged_batch_commit(void) {

4251 led_render_targets();
4252 led_commit_pending_changes();

4263static void led_set_pixel_with_duration(uint8_t led_index, uint8_t r, uint8_t g,
4264 uint8_t b, uint32_t duration_ms) {
4265 if (led_index >= CHESS_LED_COUNT_TOTAL) {
4266 ESP_LOGE(TAG, "Invalid LED index: %d", led_index);
4267 return;
4268 }
4269
4270 if (led_unified_mutex != NULL) {
4271 if (xSemaphoreTake(led_unified_mutex, LED_TASK_MUTEX_TIMEOUT_TICKS) ==
4272 pdTRUE) {
4273 uint32_t new_color = (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
4274 uint32_t current_time = esp_timer_get_time() / 1000;
4275
4276 // Save the original color if the duration is not active
4277 if (!led_durations[led_index].is_active) {
4278 led_durations[led_index].original_color = led_states[led_index];
4279 }
4280
4281 // Nastavit duration tracking
4282 led_durations[led_index].led_index = led_index;
4283 led_durations[led_index].duration_color = new_color;
4284 led_durations[led_index].start_time = current_time;
4285 led_durations[led_index].duration_ms = duration_ms;
4286 led_durations[led_index].is_active = true;
4287 led_durations[led_index].restore_original = true;
4288
4289 // Aplikovat novou barvu
4290 led_states[led_index] = new_color;
4291
4292 ESP_LOGD(TAG, "LED[%d] set with duration: RGB(%d,%d,%d) for %lums",
4293 led_index, r, g, b, duration_ms);
4294
4295 xSemaphoreGive(led_unified_mutex);
4296 } else {
4297 ESP_LOGW(TAG, "Failed to take LED mutex for duration operation");
4298 }
4299 }
4300}
4301
4311static void led_process_duration_expirations(void) {
4312 if (!led_duration_system_enabled) {
4313 return;
4314 }
4315
4316 uint32_t current_time = esp_timer_get_time() / 1000;
4317 bool state_changed = false;
4318
4319 // Take mutex (task context -> safe to wait briefly)
4320 if (led_unified_mutex != NULL) {
4321 if (xSemaphoreTake(led_unified_mutex, LED_TASK_MUTEX_TIMEOUT_TICKS) !=
4322 pdTRUE) {
4323 return;
4324 }
4325 }
4326
4327 for (int i = 0; i < CHESS_LED_COUNT_TOTAL; i++) {
4328 if (!led_durations[i].is_active) {
4329 continue;
4330 }
4331
4332 uint32_t elapsed = current_time - led_durations[i].start_time;
4333 if (elapsed < led_durations[i].duration_ms) {
4334 continue;
4335 }
4336
4337 // Restore original color if requested
4338 if (led_durations[i].restore_original) {
4339 uint32_t restore_color = led_durations[i].original_color;
4340 led_states[i] = restore_color;
4341
4342 // Mark pending changes so batch commit can refresh HW
4343 if (led_initialized && led_strip != NULL && !simulation_mode) {
4344 led_pending_changes[i] = restore_color;
4345 led_changed_flags[i] = true;
4346 led_changes_pending = true;
4347 }
4348 }
4349
4350 led_durations[i].is_active = false;
4351 state_changed = true;
4352 }
4353
4354 if (led_unified_mutex != NULL) {
4355 xSemaphoreGive(led_unified_mutex);
4356 }
4357
4358 // No immediate refresh here — main loop already calls
4359 // `led_privileged_batch_commit()`.
4360 (void)state_changed;
4361}
4362
4366static void led_init_duration_system(void) {
4367 // Clear all duration states
4368 memset(led_durations, 0, sizeof(led_durations));
4369
4370 // PRODUCTION STABILITY:
4371 // Duration expirations are processed in LED task main loop, not via FreeRTOS
4372 // timers.
4373 led_duration_system_enabled = true;
4374 ESP_LOGI(TAG, "✅ LED duration management system initialized (task-driven)");
4375}

4501// ============================================================================
4502// OTA PROGRESS LED (HTTPS / HTTP / BLE stream update)
4503// ============================================================================
4504
4505void led_ota_progress_ui(uint8_t progress_percent) {
4506 if (!led_initialized || simulation_mode || led_is_booting()) {
4507 return;
4508 }
4509 if (!led_component_enabled) {
4510 return;
4511 }
4512 if (progress_percent > 100) {
4513 progress_percent = 100;
4514 }
4515
4516 uint32_t t = xTaskGetTickCount();
4517 uint32_t pulse = 96U + (uint32_t)((t * 3U) % 48U);
4518
4519 int filled = ((int)progress_percent * CHESS_LED_COUNT_BOARD) / 100;
4520 if (progress_percent > 0 && filled == 0) {
4521 filled = 1;
4522 }
4523
4524 if (filled == 0) {
4525 uint32_t phase = (t / 6U) % 14U;
4526 if (phase > 7U) {
4527 phase = 14U - phase;
4528 }
4529 int sweep_led = (int)phase;
4530 for (int i = 0; i < CHESS_LED_COUNT_BOARD; i++) {
4531 if (i == sweep_led) {
4532 led_set_pixel_internal((uint8_t)i, (uint8_t)pulse,
4533 (uint8_t)(pulse / 2U), 0);
4534 } else if (i < 8) {
4535 led_set_pixel_internal((uint8_t)i, 0, 4, 18);
4536 } else {
4537 led_set_pixel_internal((uint8_t)i, 0, 2, 12);
4538 }
4539 }
4540 } else {
4541 int head = filled - 1;
4542 uint32_t chase = (uint32_t)((t / 5U) % (uint32_t)filled);
4543 for (int i = 0; i < CHESS_LED_COUNT_BOARD; i++) {
4544 if (i < filled) {
4545 int dist = i - head;
4546 if (dist < 0) {
4547 dist = -dist;
4548 }
4549 uint32_t dim =
4550 40U + (pulse * (uint32_t)(8 - min(dist, 7))) / 40U;
4551 if ((uint32_t)i == chase) {
4552 led_set_pixel_internal((uint8_t)i, 255, 230, 80);
4553 } else {
4554 led_set_pixel_internal(
4555 (uint8_t)i, (uint8_t)(dim + 60U), (uint8_t)(dim / 4U), 0);
4556 }
4557 } else {
4558 led_set_pixel_internal((uint8_t)i, 0, 4, 22);
4559 }
4560 }
4561 }
4562
4563 uint32_t bphase = (t / 12U) % (uint32_t)CHESS_LED_COUNT_BUTTONS;
4564 for (int b = 0; b < CHESS_LED_COUNT_BUTTONS; b++) {
4565 uint8_t li = led_get_button_led_index((uint8_t)b);
4566 if ((uint32_t)b == bphase) {
4567 led_set_pixel_internal(li, 0, (uint8_t)pulse, 200);
4568 } else {
4569 led_set_pixel_internal(li, 0, 12, 40);
4570 }
4571 }
4572
4573 led_force_immediate_update();
4574}

4583// ============================================================================
4584// BOOT ANIMATION LED FUNCTIONS
4585// ============================================================================
4586
4595/* Clock units per 25 ms. Rings overlap, so the bloom stays smooth. */
4596#define BOOT_CLOCK_STEP 18u
4597#define BOOT_FRAME_MS 25u
4598#define BOOT_RING_GAP 22u
4599#define BOOT_SQUARE_SPAN 110u
4600#define BOOT_CLOCK_END ((7u * BOOT_RING_GAP) + BOOT_SQUARE_SPAN)
4601
4602static uint16_t s_boot_clock;
4603static uint32_t s_boot_t0;
4604static bool s_boot_timed;
4605static bool s_boot_faded;
4606
4607static uint8_t boot_center_dist(uint8_t row, uint8_t col) {
4608 int dr = (int)row * 2 - 7;
4609 int dc = (int)col * 2 - 7;
4610 if (dr < 0) {
4611 dr = -dr;
4612 }
4613 if (dc < 0) {
4614 dc = -dc;
4615 }
4616 return (uint8_t)(dr > dc ? dr : dc);
4617}
4618
4619static uint8_t boot_scale(uint8_t channel, uint8_t amount, uint8_t gain) {
4620 return (uint8_t)(((uint32_t)channel * amount * gain) / (255u * 255u));
4621}
4622
4624static void boot_paint_board(uint16_t clock, uint8_t gain) {
4625 for (uint8_t row = 0; row < 8u; row++) {
4626 for (uint8_t col = 0; col < 8u; col++) {
4627 int local = (int)clock - (int)boot_center_dist(row, col) * (int)BOOT_RING_GAP;
4628 uint8_t amount = 0;
4629 if (local >= (int)BOOT_SQUARE_SPAN) {
4630 amount = 255;
4631 } else if (local > 0) {
4632 amount = led_smoothstep_u8((uint8_t)((local * 255) / (int)BOOT_SQUARE_SPAN));
4633 }
4634 bool light = ((row + col) & 1u) != 0u;
4635 uint8_t r = boot_scale(light ? 230u : 22u, amount, gain);
4636 uint8_t g = boot_scale(light ? 186u : 30u, amount, gain);
4637 uint8_t b = boot_scale(light ? 120u : 52u, amount, gain);
4638 led_set_pixel_internal(chess_pos_to_led_index(row, col), r, g, b);
4639 }
4640 }
4641}
4642
4643bool led_boot_animation_step(uint8_t progress_percent) {
4644 (void)progress_percent;
4645 if (!led_initialized || simulation_mode || s_boot_faded) {
4646 return s_boot_faded;
4647 }
4648
4649 bool covered = false;
4650 {
4651 uint32_t now = (uint32_t)(esp_timer_get_time() / 1000);
4652 uint32_t elapsed;
4653 uint32_t clock;
4654 if (!s_boot_timed) {
4655 s_boot_t0 = now;
4656 s_boot_timed = true;
4657 }
4658 elapsed = (uint32_t)(now - s_boot_t0);
4659 clock = BOOT_CLOCK_STEP + (elapsed * BOOT_CLOCK_STEP) / BOOT_FRAME_MS;
4660 if (clock > BOOT_CLOCK_END) {
4661 clock = BOOT_CLOCK_END;
4662 }
4663 s_boot_clock = (uint16_t)clock;
4664 covered = (s_boot_clock >= BOOT_CLOCK_END);
4665 }
4666
4667 boot_paint_board(s_boot_clock, 255);
4668 led_force_immediate_update();
4669 return covered;
4670}
4671
4678void led_boot_animation_fade_out(void) {
4679 // Security checks
4680 if (!led_initialized || simulation_mode) {
4681 ESP_LOGD(TAG, "LED boot fade out: %s",
4682 simulation_mode ? "simulation mode" : "not initialized");
4683 return;
4684 }
4685 if (s_boot_faded) {
4686 return;
4687 }
4688 s_boot_faded = true;
4689
4690 ESP_LOGI(TAG, "Starting LED boot animation fade out...");
4691
4692 /* Ease the checker back to black. Short, so boot does not sit on the picture. */
4693 const int fade_steps = 8;
4694 const int step_delay_ms = 12;
4695
4696 for (int step = fade_steps; step >= 0; step--) {
4697 uint8_t lin = (uint8_t)((step * 255) / fade_steps);
4698 boot_paint_board(BOOT_CLOCK_END, led_smoothstep_u8(lin));
4699 led_force_immediate_update();
4700 vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(step_delay_ms));
4701 led_task_wdt_reset_safe();
4702 }
4703
4704 led_clear_board_only();
4705 s_boot_clock = 0;
4706 s_boot_timed = false;
4707 led_booting_active = false;
4708 ESP_LOGI(TAG, "LED boot animation fade out completed");
4709}
